niche: a survey's translated versions of a twelve-item connectedness scale gated for fieldwork on the share of each version's total-score variance due to the trait, where the negatively worded items carry a wording factor in some translations

spine.entity: one interviewer-administered pilot respondent's answer to one scale item

driver: The decisive quantity is the share of a composite's variance due to the one attribute it is meant to capture, and in some versions a subset of its components shares a second source of variance unrelated to the attribute, so the components' average agreement or a single-source fit counts that second source as the attribute and passes versions whose attribute share falls short; only a fit that gives the subset its own source shows the shortfall.
driver_concrete: In five of the ten translated versions of the BCS-12 the four negatively worded items share a wording factor (the translation's rendering of negation), so Cronbach's alpha and a one-factor omega count the wording variance as connectedness and release or hold versions whose connectedness share is below the bands; a bifactor model with a wording factor on items 9 to 12 (or their correlated residuals) gives the trait's share and holds or reworks them.
stump: A competent solver gates each version on Cronbach's alpha (or a one-factor omega) and files 5 of the 10 versions wrong (the wording-affected versions released instead of held, or held instead of reworked); the step that lands it there is taking the score's whole common variance for connectedness when the negatively worded items share a wording factor in those translations.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who builds each version's valid pilot completes, reverse-scores items 9 to 12, reads the release standard's definition of reliability correctly and estimates it with Cronbach's alpha or a one-factor omega files 5 of the 10 versions wrong, releasing or holding the five wording-affected versions on variance their negatively worded items share with each other and not with connectedness.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the share of the scale score's variance due to the trait (omega hierarchical) under the measurement model each version's item responses support, with a reverse-keyed wording factor separated from the trait; with meters or wards for items there are no negatively worded statements, no translation that changes how negation is answered and no latent trait to separate from a response style, and the task stops making sense.

differentiation.task257: task257 counts a scale's dimensions when lopsided item splits distort Pearson correlations; this build estimates a trait's share of a translated version's score with a reverse-keyed wording factor separated from it.

notes: Seed DQ10: the world, decision and quantity kept; the seed's own pitfall (alpha against congeneric omega) is a wrong rung here: the decisive step is separating a wording factor that alpha and a one-factor omega both count as the trait. G17 decisive (the model the data supports), G16 supporting.
